description_en: This operation adjusts the bandwidth for an ApsaraDB for Redis instance that uses the pay-as-you-go billing method. You need to specify only the InstanceId, NodeId (optional), Bandwidth, and ChargeType parameters
description_zh: 调整云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的带宽，当前仅支持按量付费的计费方式，您仅需填写InstanceId、NodeId（可选）、Bandwidth、ChargeType参数即可
name: EnableAdditionalBandwidth

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-payment. Valid values:

true: Enables auto-payment. This is the default. Ensure that your account has a sufficient balance.

false: Disables auto-payment. You must manually complete the payment
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动付款，取值：

true：默认值，自动付款，请确保账号有足够的余额。
false：手动付款
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the data shard. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473786.html operation to query data shard IDs. Separate multiple data shard IDs with commas (,). You can also set this parameter to All to specify all data shards.

This parameter is required only when the instance uses the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52228.html or the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62870.html
parameters.help_zh:
数据分片ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473786.html获取，传入多个时使用英文逗号（,）分隔；您也可以传入**All**（即表示所有数据分片）。
当实例为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52228.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62870.html时，本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The amount of bandwidth to add, in MB/s. The value must be an integer greater than or equal to 0. The maximum value is six times the default bandwidth of the instance type or a single data shard, with an upper limit of 192 MB/s. For example, if the default bandwidth of an instance is 10 MB/s, the valid values for this parameter are 0 to 60.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473782.html operation and check the value of the DefaultBandWidth parameter in the response to get the default maximum bandwidth. For more information about instance types, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26350.html.

If you specified multiple data shard IDs for the NodeId parameter, the bandwidth values that you specify for this parameter must correspond to the order of the data shard IDs. Separate multiple bandwidth values with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
要增加的带宽，单位为MB/s。取值为大于等于0的整数 ，最大可传入该实例（或单分片）规格默认带宽的6倍，但增加的上限为192MB/s。例如实例默认带宽为10 MB/s，可增加的范围为0~60。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473782.html接口，通过返回参数**DefaultBandWidth**获取默认最大带宽。更多关于实例规格的信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26350.html。
如果请求参数NodeId传入了多个数据分片ID，本参数传入的带宽值需和数据分片ID的顺序对应，多个带宽值之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration, in days. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180, 365, 730, 1095, and 1825.

To continue using the purchased bandwidth, you must call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473804.html operation to renew the bandwidth before it expires
parameters.help_zh:
购买的时长，单位为天，取值：1、2、3、7、14、30、60、90、180、365、730、1095、1825。
如果需要继续使用购买的带宽，您需要在带宽到期前调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473804.html接口及时续费
parameters.name: order_time_length

parameters.help_en: The source of the call. This parameter is used for internal maintenance. Do not specify it
parameters.help_zh: 调用来源，本参数仅用于内部维护使用，无需传入
parameters.name: source_biz

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true: Enables auto-renewal.

false: Disables auto-renewal. This is the default
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动续费，取值：
true：开启。
false：不开启，默认值
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal period, in months. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 24, 36, and 60.

This parameter is required only when AutoRenew is set to true.

After you set this parameter, you cannot query its value by calling API operations. To check this setting, go to the console. In the top navigation bar, choose Billing > Renewal Management. Then, in the Instance ID field, enter the instance ID followed by the `-bw` suffix (for example, r-bp1zxszhcgatnx\\-bw)
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费周期，单位为月，取值：1、2、3、4、5、6、7、8、9、12、24、36、60。

当AutoRenew参数取值为true时，本参数才可用且必须传入。
该参数设置后暂不支持通过API查询，您可以在控制台的顶部菜单栏，单击费用 > 续费管理，然后在实例ID文本框中输入实例ID加`-bw`后缀（例如r-bp1zxszhcgatnx****-bw）来查询
parameters.name: auto_renew_period

parameters.help_en:
The billing method for the additional bandwidth. Valid values:

PrePaid: subscription.

PostPaid: pay-as-you-go. This is the only supported billing method
parameters.help_zh:
额外增加带宽的付费类型，取值：
PrePaid：预付费，即包年包月。
PostPaid：按量付费，当前仅支持该方式
parameters.name: charge_type
